questions.question: Why do we need food?
questions.evidence: 1. We need food to live and grow (breathe/live and grow)

questions.question: How much food should we eat to stay healthy?
questions.evidence: 2. We should eat the right (the right/less) amount of food to stay healthy

questions.question: Which food group makes our bones and muscles strong?
questions.evidence: 3. Body-building (Energy-giving/ Body-building) foods make our bones and muscles strong

questions.question: Which protects us from falling sick: nuts or eggs?
questions.evidence: 4. Nuts (Nuts/Eggs) protect us from falling sick

questions.question: How many meals do we usually eat each day?
questions.evidence: 5. We usually eat three (three/five) meals in a day

questions.question: Name two foods we get from plants.
questions.evidence: 1. Food we get from plants                   fruits         vegetables

questions.question: Name two foods we get from animals.
questions.evidence: 2. Food we get from animals                  eggs           milk

questions.question: Name two energy-giving foods.
questions.evidence: 3. Energy-giving foods                       rice           wheat

questions.question: Name two body-building foods.
questions.evidence: 4. Body-building foods                       milk           chickens

questions.question: Name two protective foods.
questions.evidence: 5. Protective foods                          vegetables     fruits

questions.question: What are the three meals we usually eat?
questions.evidence: We usually have three meals during the day. They are breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

questions.question: When should we wash our hands?
questions.evidence: iii. We should wash our hands before and after eating.

questions.question: Should we eat well-cooked food?
questions.evidence: i. We should eat well-cooked food.

questions.question: Why can dirty hands make us sick?
questions.evidence: Ans. Yes, He can fall sick because his dirty hands contain many germs.

questions.question: Roshni eats rice and wheat but no fruits or vegetables. What food group is she missing?
questions.evidence: Ans. No, Roshni is not eating healthy foods because she is not eating protective foods such as fruits, vegetables
